summary: Install-time host reconnaissance beacon to webhook.site
details: package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks that shell out to curl and transmit installer identity to a hardcoded webhook.site inbox (https://webhook.site/d80b4602-8a87-4693-8510-6ff77c62788e/blots). The query string carries `whoami` (OS username), `hostname` (machine name), `$PWD` (install working directory), and a Unix timestamp. Both hooks fire automatically on `npm install` without any user interaction or consent, and webhook.site is a throwaway request-capture service commonly used as attacker infrastructure for reconnaissance beacons.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
